meta.disclaimer: This is a planning shortlist, not live availability. Road access, facilities, rates and seasonal opening can change. Confirm the exact site and vehicle requirement with the linked authority or operator before paying.

sites.name: Sesriem Campsite
sites.accessNote: The campsite is at the Sesriem gateway. The final deep-sand section to Sossusvlei requires the park shuttle or a suitable 4×4; campsite access does not remove that constraint.
sites.seasonNote: Open dates and gate arrangements should be confirmed with NWR; peak dry-season space can be scarce.
sites.safetyNote: Plan fuel and water before leaving the larger service towns.

sites.name: Okaukuejo Campsite
sites.accessNote: The southern Etosha gateway and internal tourist roads are normally usable by standard vehicles, but temporary restrictions can follow heavy rain.
sites.seasonNote: Open year-round in normal operations; reserve early for the dry-season wildlife months.
sites.safetyNote: Remain inside camp after gate closure and allow conservative driving time inside Etosha.

sites.name: Skukuza Rest Camp — camping
sites.accessNote: Reached on Kruger's surfaced tourist-road network. Gate times still determine how late you can arrive.
sites.seasonNote: Normally open year-round, subject to SANParks operational notices and weather disruptions.
sites.safetyNote: Check SANParks notices before travel; floods can alter which gates and roads are usable.

sites.name: Satara Rest Camp — camping
sites.accessNote: Reached on Kruger's tourist-road network; use SANParks travel times rather than ordinary highway averages.
sites.seasonNote: Normally open year-round, subject to park notices. Summer storms can disrupt internal access.
sites.safetyNote: Arrive before camp gate closure and never plan an after-dark transfer inside the park.

sites.name: Third Bridge Campsite
sites.accessNote: Remote sand, water and changing track conditions make this a proper 4×4 journey. Ask the operator about the current approach and water crossings.
sites.seasonNote: Access changes with flood and rain conditions; never infer drivability from the calendar alone.
sites.safetyNote: The campsite is unfenced wilderness. Store food securely and follow staff instructions around wildlife.

sites.name: Hwange Main Camp — camping
sites.accessNote: Main Camp is approached from the Bulawayo–Victoria Falls road. Internal park roads and seasonal conditions can make higher clearance valuable.
sites.seasonNote: Confirm current camp operations, road access and supplies through ZimParks before departure.
sites.safetyNote: Bring camping equipment, food, lighting and a first-aid kit; do not assume supplies are available.

sites.name: Nyamepi public campsite
sites.accessNote: ZimParks requires high clearance for Mana Pools access because of road conditions. Obtain the required Zambezi Valley entry permit.
sites.seasonNote: Road access is strongly seasonal. Confirm the park opening, permit process and campsite category before setting out.
sites.safetyNote: This is a wildlife area with limited services. Bring lighting, insect protection, water and full camp supplies.

sites.name: Wildlife Camp — campsite
sites.accessNote: The camp is outside South Luangwa National Park. Confirm the final road and seasonal vehicle advice directly when booking.
sites.seasonNote: The operator publishes peak and green-season periods; access and activities should be reconfirmed for the selected dates.
sites.safetyNote: Wild animals move through the wider area. Follow the camp's movement and nighttime guidance.

sites.name: Fat Monkeys — camping
sites.accessNote: Cape Maclear is reached by public road, but potholes and rain can change the final approach. Ask for current directions before arrival.
sites.seasonNote: The operator accepts camping reservations online; confirm lake-season conditions and availability for your dates.
sites.safetyNote: Ask locally about safe swimming areas and current bilharzia guidance rather than assuming all shoreline water is suitable.

sites.name: Chitengo Campsite
sites.accessNote: The park advises higher clearance for private vehicles accessing Chitengo. Arrive before the main gate closes.
sites.seasonNote: Rain can close or restrict park access. Confirm the operating season directly before building it into a long-distance route.
sites.safetyNote: Buy supplies before arrival; the park notes that the nearest shop is a long drive from Chitengo.

sites.name: Malealea Lodge Campground
sites.accessNote: Road works and mountain weather can change the approach. Ask the lodge for the current route and vehicle advice before leaving the main road.
sites.seasonNote: Summer brings most rain and winter nights can be cold; carry a mountain-ready sleep system.
sites.safetyNote: Use a local guide for unmarked hiking routes, as recommended by the operator.

sites.name: Mlilwane Rest Camp — camping
sites.accessNote: The main Rest Camp is a practical road-trip stop in the Ezulwini Valley. Confirm the correct camping area when reserving.
sites.seasonNote: Generally suitable year-round; summer rain and holiday demand can affect plans.
sites.safetyNote: Use only designated camping areas and follow sanctuary instructions around animals.
